messages:
Lena P: FYI we have ~65 invoices with unexpected negative prorated charges after last night's usage-report job. Looks like multi-seat proration got applied twice for a subset of customers. Affected invoices created between 2026-03-17 03:05-03:25 UTC.

Victor M: Is this the same class of duplication as yesterday? or different root cause?

Lena P: Different symptom. Yesterday was duplicated credit memos from webhook replays. This looks like the usage-aggregation job emitted two proration adjustments for the same subscription change.

Ashwin: digging in. The usage-agg pipeline has a new deploy (infra#5471) that changed timezone handling when converting local change_time -> UTC. For events near midnight PST the commit path generated a duplicate prune boundary and we fed the proration calculator the same change twice.

Billing Bot: [alert] usage-aggregation #usage-nightly FAILED?WARN at 2026-03-17T03:27:43Z. See /logs/usage/2026-03-17/03.

Lena P: Example log for sub sub_778:

```
2026-03-17T03:06:12Z INFO usage-agg process change_id change_555 subscription sub_778 local_change_time 2026-03-16T19:00:12-08:00 -> normalized 2026-03-17T03:00:12Z
2026-03-17T03:06:12Z INFO proration calc for sub_778 delta -30 seats prorate_amount -120.00
2026-03-17T03:06:13Z INFO usage-agg process change_id change_555 (replayed) local_change_time 2026-03-16T19:00:12-08:00 -> normalized 2026-03-17T03:00:12Z
2026-03-17T03:06:13Z INFO proration calc for sub_778 delta -30 seats prorate_amount -120.00
```

Victor M: Where did the replay come from? The pipeline shouldn't reprocess the same change_id.

Ashwin: It did. The dedupe key uses change_id + partition_id, but our recent Kafka consumer change moved partition metadata into the message header instead of payload. The reprocessor (which reconstructs messages) didn't re-add partition_id, so the consumer treated two messages as distinct because partition_id defaulted to "0" on one path.

Lena P: Oof. So two proration adjustments posted to Stripe as separate invoice items?

Ashwin: Yes. NetSuite received them as two negative line items (proration) and the invoice net was reduced twice.

CS Lead: We have a customer already opened a ticket (TKT-6132) complaining about balance change. Any customers with >$75 delta should be notified.

Lena P: Running a quick query to find affected invoices:

```
SELECT invoice_num, customer_id, COUNT(*) as proration_line_count, SUM(amount) as total_prorate
FROM ns_invoice_lines
WHERE memo LIKE '%prorate%' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-17 03:00' AND '2026-03-17 03:30'
GROUP BY invoice_num, customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
-- returns 65 rows
```

Victor M: Short-term: pause usage-aggregation reprocesses and revert infra#5471 rollout. I'll roll the consumer change back to the previous commit.

Ashwin: rollback started at 03:40 UTC. I also added a quick fix to the reprocessor to include partition_id when reconstructing messages. Will push a patch and tests (infra#5473).

Billing Bot: [info] reconciliation-dryrun produced 65 candidates, total amount $2,860. CSV in /artifacts/2026-03-17/usage-prorate-dryrun-2166001234.csv

Lena P: For remediation Finance wants: 1) list of invoice ids and NS line ids 2) decide void vs journal entry (prefer void of the duplicate proration line) 3) update customer notifications. I created a sheet: https://go/gdoc/usage-prorate-2026-03-17 (internal).

CS Lead: I'll draft messages for customers >$75 and queue via Intercom once Finance approves the void list.

Victor M: After rollback, add an integration test that replays messages with and without partition headers to ensure dedupe still works. Filed infra#5474.

Ashwin: Also scheduling a small backfill to detect invoices in that 03:00-03:30 window with >1 prorate line and add a review flag to ns_work_items. Will run in dry-run first.

Lena P: Please don't run voids until I ack the final CSV. I'll triage and approve in ~45m.

Billing Bot: [resolved] usage-nightly alert cleared at 2026-03-17T04:10:01Z.

Victor M: Postmortem action items: update runbook 'usage/agg-reprocess' to require partition metadata preservation, add alert for "duplicate-prorate-lines > 5 in 30m", and coordinate with CS for customer comms.

Lena P: Thanks all. We'll include a note in the billing postmortem and schedule a follow-up to reconcile ledgers. :white_check_mark:
